q: How do I choose the right CCTV camera?
a: It depends on where the camera will go, what you need to see, the lighting and your budget. Dome cameras suit ceilings and covered spots, bullet cameras suit walls and perimeters, and PTZ cameras cover wide areas. A site assessment is the best way to decide.
